help.slug: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only (e.g. residence-permit). It becomes part of the public URL: changing it changes the link.
help.italian_term: The term people will meet in real life, e.g. Permesso di soggiorno.
help.source_url: Must be https. For an "official" source the domain must be on the official allow-list.
help.source_type: Official sources are checked against the official domain list.
help.last_verified_at: The day someone last checked the information at the source. It cannot be in the future.
help.rights_note: Where the question comes from and the licence that lets EXPA use it (at least 5 characters). Required to publish.

content.confirmDelete: Delete this item permanently? Only drafts and archived items can be deleted.

content.sourceOptional: A source is optional for this kind of content.
content.readonly: You have read-only access to this item.
content.locked: This item is approved or published. Only people who can publish may edit it.
content.warnReview: This item is in review. Saving any change sends it back to draft and it must be submitted for review again.
content.warnLive: This item is live or approved. Saving re-checks the publishing rules (translations, source, links); if they fail, the change is rejected.
content.empty: No items have been created yet.

users.escalation: The server refused this change. Privileged roles can only be granted or revoked by a super admin, you cannot change your own roles, and accounts that hold a privileged role can only be changed by a super admin.
users.statusForbidden: The server refused this change. You cannot suspend your own account, and accounts with a privileged role can only be changed by a super admin.
users.selfNote: This is your own account: you cannot change its status or roles here.
users.privilegedNote: This account holds a privileged role. Only a super admin can change its status or roles.

roles.subtitle: Read-only matrix of what each role may do. Roles are managed in the backend configuration.

jobs.noSourcesHelp: Add a feed that you are legally allowed to import.
jobs.keyHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. Cannot be changed later.
jobs.activeHelp: Active sources are imported on schedule.
jobs.activeBlocked: Document the legal basis (at least 20 characters) before activating.
jobs.legalHelp: Where the permission to import this feed comes from (licence, API terms, written agreement). Required before the source can be activated.
jobs.legalRequired: A source cannot be activated before documenting the legal basis (at least 20 characters).
jobs.legalWarning: Without a documented legal basis this source stays inactive. EXPA only imports feeds whose automated use is permitted.
jobs.configCreate: Enter the feed address and, if needed, headers. For security the API will never show them again.
jobs.configNeverShown: The feed URL and headers are never shown (they may contain secrets). Current host: {host}. Headers set: {headers}. To change them, enter NEW values below; empty fields keep the current ones.
jobs.urlHelp: Must be https and a public address.
jobs.headersHelp: For example an API key header. Values are hidden while typing.
jobs.headersReplace: Adding headers REPLACES all existing headers.
jobs.mapHelp: Which field of the feed fills each job field (for example title = job_title).
jobs.runQueued: Import queued. Refresh the run history in a moment.
jobs.runInactive: Only active sources can be run.
